robot: Two-jaw grippers with a 95 mm opening. Leader and follower arms. Arms are never named in tasks.
bench: Six-zone bench on a mat inside a white tent with overhead lights and a ring light; a triple foot pedal records.
standing: Creative, manipulation-rich real tasks clients worldwide would buy; not simple pick-and-place; simple and doable, never senseless.
Never redo a platform task; an existing platform job may appear only as a reverse.
Always check whether a reverse is possible.
Anything put into a box, bag or jar needs extra light so it shows on camera; prefer clear or white bags.
Liquids: red water standard, blue allowed per episode, never a separate task. Liquids and the RIVER power strip never share a task. Plastic before glass.
Big black nuts and bolts only.
Drills allowed but keep their use simple.
A missing item is written as 'Needs: <item>' with why it is needed and whether the task still works without it.
Items used in platform tasks count as in stock.
One task per kind of job; never two tasks that differ only in colour.
